projects.name: Self-Introduction
projects.desc: 以「星轨展台」为灵感的沉浸式 3D 个人主页，5 个可切换角色、环绕物交互、流体光标、无人机粒子文字、中英双语与全屏模式。
projects.descEn: An immersive 3D portfolio inspired by orbit showcases — 5 switchable characters, orbiting interactives, fluid cursor, drone particle text, bilingual UI and fullscreen mode.

模型预加载 + GPU 预热
OrbitControls 拖拽环绕
GitHub Pages 零成本部署
highlightsEn: 5 random entrance animations
Model preload + GPU warmup
OrbitControls drag-to-orbit
Zero-cost GitHub Pages deploy

projects.name: CineRec
projects.desc: 8 个推荐模型在 MovieLens 100K 与 Amazon Video_Games 上按统一协议对比；内容塔融合 Sentence-BERT 文本、ResNet-50 图像与题材特征，并做模态消融与冷启动实验。
projects.descEn: Eight recommenders compared under one protocol on MovieLens 100K and Amazon Video_Games; a content tower fuses Sentence-BERT text, ResNet-50 image and genre features, with modality ablation and cold-start experiments.
highlights: 8 模型 / 2 数据集统一协议：HR、NDCG、Recall + 多种子
MultiModalNCF HR@10 0.3650 / NDCG@10 0.0859
Sentence-BERT + ResNet-50 + 题材特征内容塔
模态消融 + 冷启动实验，定位内容信息真实贡献
FastAPI + Streamlit 双 Demo，附预印本
highlightsEn: 8 models / 2 datasets under one protocol: HR, NDCG, Recall + multiple seeds
MultiModalNCF HR@10 0.3650 / NDCG@10 0.0859
Sentence-BERT + ResNet-50 + genre content tower
Modality ablation + cold-start to isolate the real contribution of content
FastAPI + Streamlit demos, with preprint

papers.title: CineRec: A Practical Multi-Modal Recommender Study with Cross-Dataset Validation and Published-Baseline Comparison

projects.name: AeroRec
projects.desc: 推荐全链路工程复现 + 偏差诊断研究：在真值与倾向可精确计算的 Oracle 环境中拆解召回、排序、混排三阶段，对比 naive 与 IPS/SNIPS 去偏，并用参数扫描与 bootstrap 给出有效边界。
projects.descEn: Full recommendation pipeline reproduction plus a bias-diagnosis study: an Oracle environment with known ground truth and propensities splits recall, ranking and mixed ranking, comparing naive against IPS/SNIPS debiasing with parameter scans and bootstrap.
highlights: Oracle 环境：真值 + 倾向可精确计算，naive vs IPS/SNIPS 对照
Two-Tower 双塔 + ItemCF + 规则四路召回
DeepFM (FM+DNN) CTR 排序 + 多目标混排 + 降级兜底
参数扫描 + bootstrap 估计去偏有效边界
在线推理 P50 0.7ms / P99 1ms，附中英双语面板
highlightsEn: Oracle environment with exact ground truth and propensities; naive vs IPS/SNIPS
Two-Tower + ItemCF + rule-based four-way recall
DeepFM (FM+DNN) CTR ranking + multi-objective mixing + fallback
Parameter scans + bootstrap to map the effective boundary of debiasing
Online inference P50 0.7 ms / P99 1 ms, bilingual panel

papers.title: Bias Propagation and Effective Boundaries of Debiasing in Recommender Systems: An Oracle-Based Diagnosis Study

projects.name: MetaNutri
projects.tagline: 精准营养代谢数字孪生（含 PPGR 血糖预测）
projects.desc: 全栈平台 + 独立研究模块。在 45 名受试者上做留一受试者交叉验证（LOPO），并在 16 人队列做外部验证：比较均值预测、Ridge 与 XGBoost，配套 conformal 预测区间、方差分解与混合效应模型；另建 200 题 RAG 基准与可溯源问答应用。
projects.descEn: Full-stack platform + independent research module. Leave-one-participant-out (LOPO) validation on 45 participants with external validation on 16, comparing mean predictors, Ridge and XGBoost, with conformal intervals, variance decomposition and mixed-effects models; plus a 200-question RAG benchmark and a citation-traceable QA app.
highlights: 43 REST endpoints / 8 数据集 / 17 页技术报告
45 人 LOPO + 16 人外部验证，2-h AUC r=0.890（早餐）/ 0.838（全餐）
conformal 预测区间 + 方差分解 + 混合效应模型
200 题 RAG 基准：规则判官 + 人工复核 + 三模型误差归因
模型导出 JSON，运行时无需训练栈
highlightsEn: 43 REST endpoints / 8 datasets / 17-page technical report
LOPO on 45 participants + external validation on 16; 2-h AUC r=0.890 (breakfast) / 0.838 (all meals)
Conformal prediction intervals + variance decomposition + mixed-effects models
200-question RAG benchmark: rule judges + manual review + 3-model error attribution
Model exported as JSON, no training stack at runtime

papers.title: Measurement Reliability Confounds Cross-Regime Comparisons of Postprandial Glucose Prediction
NutriQA: A Traceable RAG Question-Answering Benchmark and Empirical Study on Official Chinese Nutrition Data

projects.name: PixelForge
projects.tagline: 图像超分与低光增强全流程
projects.desc: 从零手写的端到端视觉流水线：SRCNN ×2、SRResNet ×4 与低光增强 U-Net，覆盖 DIV2K / LOL 数据、Charbonnier + VGG 感知损失、余弦退火与混合精度，再到 TorchScript、FastAPI、Streamlit 与 Docker。
projects.descEn: An end-to-end restoration pipeline written from scratch: SRCNN ×2, SRResNet ×4 and a low-light U-Net, trained on DIV2K / LOL with Charbonnier + VGG perceptual loss, cosine annealing and mixed precision, then exported to TorchScript and shipped via FastAPI, Streamlit and Docker.
highlights: SR×4 PSNR 27.47 (+0.77dB vs bicubic)
SR×2 PSNR 32.35 / 低光 PSNR 18.32
Charbonnier + VGG 感知损失 / Adam / 余弦退火 / AMP
DIV2K + LOL 双数据集，统一 Bicubic 与 no-op 基线
TorchScript + FastAPI + Streamlit + Docker/CI，含经典算法兜底
highlightsEn: SR×4 PSNR 27.47 (+0.77 dB vs bicubic)
SR×2 PSNR 32.35 / low-light PSNR 18.32
Charbonnier + VGG perceptual loss / Adam / cosine annealing / AMP
DIV2K + LOL, unified Bicubic and no-op baselines
TorchScript + FastAPI + Streamlit + Docker/CI with classical fallback

papers.title: The Protocol is the Result: How Evaluation Choices Flip the Verdict on Lightweight Image Restoration

心愿一键点亮为已打卡
云端 rpc 聚合统计（省份/年度最远点）
游客免登录 + 邮箱/Google 登录云端同步
highlightsEn: Map route lines & animation
Wishlist one-click to checked-in
Cloud rpc aggregate stats (province/year farthest)
Guest mode + email/Google login cloud sync
